title: Multigrid Preconditioning for FEEC using Mass-Lumping and Transforming Smoothers
summary: For PDEs naturally posed in the de Rham complex, structure-preserving mixed and saddle-point finite element discretizations typically produce indefinite linear systems. We propose a multigrid preconditioning framework that combines mass-lumped (explicitly invertible) FEEC mass matrices with transforming smoothers that map the operator to a block form with positive definite diagonal blocks, enabling Gauss-Seidel-type relaxation on the transformed system.
